scope: Exact tracked project Source and Config plus project descriptor/build file and text-based authoring/validation scripts. No private development history, engine implementation, user saves, generated config, raw media or binary assets.
secret_scan: Bounded known credential patterns, zero matches; not a universal secret-detection guarantee.
excluded_asset_policy: Binary Content and raw imports are omitted from this code review export. This does not claim that all omitted assets are restricted. City Sample and ElevenLabs raw files must not be made public as an asset/audio library. Own asset reconstruction scripts and acquisition guidance are included.
symlink_policy: Source/Aftershock is a git symlink alias to JamProject/Aftershock. It is exported as the same UTF-8 target bytes (the Windows non-symlink checkout representation), not as extra implementation code.
